设计意图： This factor combines volatility regime switching with volume median deviation. The base regime signal (momentum in high vol, contrarian in low vol) is strengthened when volume is above its median (confirming) and weakened when volume is low (suggesting noise). The volume adjustment aims to improve rank consistency and nonlinear information capture.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

factor = regime * (close - close_10) * (1 + 0.5 * vol_dev), where regime = sign(vol_20 - med_vol_60), vol_dev = volume / ts_median(20, volume) - 1
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(multiply((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > ts_median(ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20), 60)), 2), 1), subtract(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 10)))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(multiply((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > ts_median(ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20), 60)), 2), 1)
  4. 4. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > ts_median(ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20), 60)), 2)

    ts_median(ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20), 60)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_mediann 期滚动中位数
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 vol_20：ret.滚动窗口(20).std()
  3. 计算 med_vol_60：vol_20.滚动窗口(60).median()
  4. 计算 regime：((vol_20 > med_vol_60).astype(int) * 2) - 1
  5. 计算 price_change：close - close.shift(10)
  6. 计算 vol_med_20：volume.滚动窗口(20).median()
  7. 计算 vol_dev：(volume / vol_med_20) - 1
  8. 计算 factor：regime * price_change * (1 + 0.5 * vol_dev)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_vol_volume_regime(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() vol_20 = ret.rolling(20).std() med_vol_60 = vol_20.rolling(60).median() regime = ((vol_20 > med_vol_60).astype(int) * 2) - 1 price_change = df_copy["close"] - df_copy["close"].shift(10) vol_med_20 = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20).median() vol_dev = (df_copy["volume"] / vol_med_20) - 1 factor = regime * price_change * (1 + 0.5 * vol_dev) df_copy["factor_vol_volume_regime"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_vol_volume_regime"]
